content:
The feed has no destination. Kahana does. The feed asks you to keep moving. The Library invites you to stay.

You already do the collecting

If you teach, perform, or explain something on Instagram or YouTube, you already have more than the clip. Notes apps, bookmarks, Drive folders, voice memos, a class you taught once. The feed shows what comes next. A hub shows where something can lead.

You have scrolled the whole internet and arrived nowhere. Somewhere between unlimited access and endless scrolling, the path got lost. Kahana is where that path can become a place again.

Stop publishing another fragment

A reel is a door. It is not the room. Put the tutorial, the music files, the behind-the-scenes, and the workshop in one hub. Keep posting where your people already are. Link the hub from the caption, the profile, and the end screen.

You can leave the hub free, or set a price when the pack is worth paying for. Kahana takes 5% when someone pays. The rest is yours. Details are on earn money and benefits for creators.

What rises is not the newest post

A feed forgets yesterday. Aura is a scarce daily signal from a person who found the work useful. It does not reset when an algorithm changes. Read how five sparks work and why the Aura Library matters.
